elements.note: Full frame, close-up: the presenter speaks the hook to camera, face in the upper half, a microphone in shot.

textBlocks.note: The topic in the accent colour (yellow), uppercase: the first line of a two-line title.
Second line in white, uppercase, same size: the promise ("EXPLAINED").
A small lower-case qualifier in brackets under the title ("(in 3 simple steps)"): how long or how easy.

note: Talking-head hook with a designed title over the chest, under the face, so it never covers the face. Two-colour title (topic in accent, promise in white) plus a small qualifier is a clear hierarchy. Two thin '+' marks at the title's height, near both side edges, frame it lightly.
